prompt: How many bones are in one adult human hand (including the wrist)?
sourceNote: The hand has 27 bones: 8 carpals in the wrist, 5 metacarpals in the palm and 14 phalanges in the fingers.

prompt: How many bones are in the adult human body?
sourceNote: A typical adult skeleton has 206 bones. Babies are born with around 270, and many fuse together as they grow.

prompt: How many teeth does a full set of adult human teeth have (including wisdom teeth)?
sourceNote: A full adult set is 32 teeth: 8 incisors, 4 canines, 8 premolars and 12 molars, including 4 wisdom teeth.

prompt: How many hearts does an octopus have?
sourceNote: An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills and one pumps it around the body.

prompt: How many vertebrae are in a giraffe's neck?
sourceNote: Giraffes have 7 neck vertebrae, the same as humans. Each one can be over 25 cm long.

prompt: How many chemical elements are on the periodic table?
sourceNote: 118 elements have been discovered and named. The last four (113, 115, 117 and 118) were named in 2016.

prompt: The speed of light in a vacuum, in kilometres per second (rounded down to a whole number)?
sourceNote: The speed of light is defined as exactly 299,792,458 metres per second, about 299,792 km per second.

prompt: The average distance from Earth to the Moon, in kilometres?
sourceNote: The average Earth to Moon distance is about 384,400 km. It varies between roughly 363,000 and 405,000 km over each orbit.

prompt: The height of Mount Everest in metres (2020 survey)?
sourceNote: A joint China and Nepal survey in 2020 measured Everest at 8,848.86 m above sea level.

prompt: The height of Mount Logan, Canada's tallest mountain, in metres?
sourceNote: Mount Logan in Yukon is 5,959 m tall, the highest peak in Canada and the second highest in North America.

prompt: The height of Toronto's CN Tower, in metres?
sourceNote: The CN Tower is 553.3 m tall. It was the world's tallest free-standing structure from 1975 until 2007.

prompt: How many steps are in the CN Tower's stairwell (the one used for charity climbs)?
sourceNote: The CN Tower's stairwell has 1,776 steps, climbed every year in charity stair-climb events.

prompt: The architectural height of Dubai's Burj Khalifa, in metres?
sourceNote: The Burj Khalifa's architectural height is 828 m, the tallest building in the world since 2010.

prompt: The total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China, in kilometres (2012 Chinese government survey)?
sourceNote: A 2012 survey by China's State Administration of Cultural Heritage measured all sections of the wall at 21,196 km.

prompt: The official length of a marathon, in metres?
sourceNote: The marathon was fixed at 42.195 km (26 miles 385 yards) in 1921, based on the 1908 London Olympics course.

prompt: How many keys are on a standard modern piano?
sourceNote: Modern pianos have 88 keys: 52 white and 36 black, covering just over seven octaves.

prompt: How many spaces are around the edge of a standard Monopoly board?
sourceNote: A Monopoly board has 40 spaces: 28 properties, 3 Chance, 3 Community Chest, 2 taxes and 4 corners.

prompt: How many tiles come in a standard English-language Scrabble set?
sourceNote: The standard English Scrabble set has 100 tiles, including 2 blanks.

prompt: Add up every number on a European roulette wheel (0 to 36). What's the total?
sourceNote: A European wheel has the numbers 0 to 36. Added together they total 666, which is why roulette is nicknamed 'the devil's game'.

prompt: How many pips (dots) are there in total across a standard double-six domino set?
sourceNote: A double-six set has 28 tiles. Each number from 0 to 6 appears 8 times, so the pips total 8 × 21 = 168.

prompt: How many member states does the United Nations have?
sourceNote: The UN has 193 member states. The most recent to join was South Sudan in 2011.

prompt: How many UN member states are in Africa?
sourceNote: Africa has 54 UN member states, more than any other continent.

prompt: How many time zones does Russia use?
sourceNote: Russia uses 11 time zones, from UTC+2 in Kaliningrad to UTC+12 in Kamchatka.

prompt: How many provinces and territories does Canada have, combined?
sourceNote: Canada has 10 provinces and 3 territories. Nunavut, the newest, was created in 1999.

prompt: How many regular-season NHL goals did Wayne Gretzky score in his career?
sourceNote: Wayne Gretzky scored 894 regular-season NHL goals, a record that stood until Alex Ovechkin passed it in 2025.

prompt: How many regular-season NHL points (goals + assists) did Wayne Gretzky record in his career?
sourceNote: Gretzky finished with 2,857 regular-season points (894 goals and 1,963 assists), still the NHL record.

prompt: How many Pokémon are in the original Pokédex of Pokémon Red and Blue?
sourceNote: Pokémon Red and Blue (1996 in Japan) have 151 Pokémon, from Bulbasaur to Mew.

prompt: How many episodes of Breaking Bad were made?
sourceNote: Breaking Bad ran for 62 episodes over 5 seasons, from 2008 to 2013.

prompt: How many episodes of Friends were made, across all 10 seasons?
sourceNote: Friends ran for 236 episodes over 10 seasons, from 1994 to 2004.

prompt: How many official Eon Productions James Bond films have been released (up to No Time to Die)?
sourceNote: Eon Productions released 25 Bond films from Dr. No (1962) to No Time to Die (2021).

prompt: How many minutes are in a 365-day year?
sourceNote: 365 days × 24 hours × 60 minutes = 525,600 minutes, the number in the song from Rent.

prompt: Roughly how many times does a heart beating at 70 beats per minute beat in one day?
sourceNote: A resting adult heart usually beats 60 to 100 times a minute. At 70 bpm that's 100,800 beats a day.
